correctness.rationale: For all cardinalities 1..14, affine and Jacobi-complement reductions cover every row set. Necessity of divisor balance follows from the independently inspected original rank-block argument. All 19 balanced affine representatives of sizes 1..7 were constructed exhaustively; five have explicit identical-zero determinant coefficient vectors in Z[X]/(X^15-1). For the other 14 orbits, every one of 54928 maximal minors is nonzero in at least one of F_31 (zeta=7) or F_61 (zeta=12), both primitive fifteenth-root specializations. A complex-zero cyclotomic determinant must specialize to zero in both fields, yielding a contradiction. The standalone exact checker was executed successfully and prints the certified seven-cardinality counts.

value.rationale: The natural deterministic full-spark problem requires classifying maximally erasure-robust selections of DFT rows. This is a complete nontrivial first-odd-semiprime classification: among all balanced 15-point row sets, it isolates precisely five extra affine obstructions and proves a surprising size-dependent failure/recovery/failure at 5/6/7 rows, with a sharp count of 2310. Neither prime-power uniformity nor low-cardinality generic results settle it. The scope is finite but mathematically canonical and fully classified, not an arbitrary slice or routine numerical table.
